items.review_rationale: Read the complete subbasis characterization for an existing topology; distinguished its finite-intersection family from the resulting basis and retained the empty intersection convention.

references.context: Set theory and topology: finite intersection of a family of open sets

references.disposition: The zero-fold finite intersection is by convention X, not an assertion of extra structure.

items.review_rationale: Read the full equivariance identity, checked that the same group acts on both domain and codomain, and distinguished a G-equivariant map from a homomorphism of groups.

references.phrase: f(g·x)=g·f(x) for all g and x
references.disposition: This displayed equation is the action-intertwining property and does not imply freeness, transitivity or bijectivity.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed the map G×X to X and both action axioms, keeping identity and multiplication order intact and avoiding the opposite order used for right actions.

references.disposition: The identity-action axiom is explicitly required for every x.
The left-action composition axiom uses the indicated order of multiplication.

items.review_rationale: Read the full geometrically reduced k-algebra condition, retaining the quantifier over every extension field K and reducedness after scalar extension; ordinary reducedness of A alone is insufficient.

references.context: Commutative algebra: algebra over a field k with structural unital homomorphism k→A
Commutative algebra: extension of scalar algebras by tensor product and its induced multiplication

references.disposition: Reducedness is required after arbitrary field extensions, not just algebraic or finite ones.
